description: Plain decode with the token-major prefill (CAMELID_GEMMA4_PREFILL_CHUNK_TOKENS=0). A hypothesis probe, not a candidate: token-major prefill is ~2.2x slower, but it walks all 30 layers per token, so it leaves the expert arena holding a CROSS-LAYER set instead of the last layer's union. If the decode warm-up curve flattens against the layer-major arm, the warm-up is an arena-handoff artifact and worth fixing directly; if it does not, the warm-up is decode's own working set and this door is closed.
